heroLead: Pick a room on the floor plan, book a slot, get a 5-digit code. Stick a QR on the door. Staff scan, enter the code, check in. No shared spreadsheet. No extra hardware.
bullet0: Floor plan shows who is in which room, when
bullet1: Confirmed booking issues a door code, not a PDF
bullet2: QR + keypad is the access system
heroShotAlt: Office floor plan with coloured pins on rooms 1001 to 1005 and a room timeline underneath
flowTitle: From the plan to the door
flowLead: Same shape as reimbursement: capture in the real world, then the software does the rest.
seeLead: Answered on the map, not in a spreadsheet. Scrub the day on the opening plan, then tap a pin. That room’s calendar opens already pointed at Book this slot.
seeFeat0Body: Pins on 1001–1005. Green available, amber booked, red in meeting, grey ended.
seeFeat1Body: Scrub morning, afternoon, evening. The pins and the Gantt follow the cursor.
seeFeat2Body: The pin opens that room’s week, 07:00–23:00, so a clash is visible before you open the form.
seeFeat3Body: Tap a room → that week’s calendar → Book this slot with room, date, and time already filled.
pinAlt: Floor-plan pin opened onto that room’s week calendar, with Book this slot
bookTitle: Book in seconds. The confirmation is a code you can use at the door, not a PDF.
bookLead: Title, room, date, start and end, participants, purpose, host, approver. Overlap check before submit — no double-book. Show the current booking calendar on the form. Confirm immediately.
bookFeat0Body: Overlap check runs before submit. A taken slot never becomes a second booking.
bookFeat1Body: See the week for that room while you still have the request open.
bookFeat2Body: Success is a large 5-digit room access code with a copy-code button.
bookFeat3Body: 07:00–23:00, colour by room, so your week is a plan, not an inbox.
formAlt: Room booking form with title, room, date, start and end, participants, purpose, host, and approver filled in
overlapAlt: Booking form stopping a double-book with an overlap error
codeAlt: Booking confirmed screen with a large 5-digit room access code and copy-code button
weekAlt: Weekly My Bookings calendar from 07:00 to 23:00, colour-coded by room
scanTitle: Facilities deploy a sticker, not a lock.
scanLead: Room QR Generator — one QR per room, download as SVG, stick it on the door. Scan opens that room’s keypad.
scanFeat0Body: One code per room. Download the SVG. That is the hardware.
scanFeat1Body: The sticker points at that room. The phone is already the kiosk.
qrAlt: Printable QR card for room 1001, ready to download as SVG
enterLead: Enter the 5-digit code. Wrong code shakes and resets. Right code → Check in (Booked → Active) then Check out (Active → Ended). Check-in and check-out times are stored.
enterFeat0Body: Five boxes. The code from the confirmation screen is the only key.
enterFeat1Body: A wrong code shakes, clears, and waits again. No lock to re-key.
enterFeat2Body: Booked becomes Active, then Ended. The times stay on the booking.
keypadAlt: Phone keypad for room 1001, five empty digit boxes
wrongAlt: Door keypad after a wrong code, shaken and reset
checkinAlt: Check-in overlay: booking moved from Booked to Active
checkoutAlt: Check-out overlay: meeting ended, booking moved from Active to Ended
ctaTitle: Ready for rooms that do not live in a spreadsheet?
ctaSubtitle: We will walk the floor plan, the door code, and a QR sticker against your office — then show how enquiry lands with FDS.
